text:
Ana (AE): Hey @Devin, Cove Labs wants to run a POC of their Langridge-13B-quant model on Redwood (private deployment). They need compatibility checks, a pricing ballpark, and security pre-reqs. Can you help outline the onboarding checklist?

Devin (SE): Quick questions first — is the model a Hugging Face export? Is it post-quantized (INT8/4-bit) or GGML/LLM.cpp format? Also: causal vs seq2seq, tokenizer type, and whether they rely on any custom CUDA ops.

Marta (ML Eng): For compatibility we need: model config (architectural flags), tokenizer files, and a small eval set (50-100 prompts). If it's 4-bit we have q4 kernels; if INT8 we prefer PTQ pipeline. Rotor/rope vs rotary embeddings matters for kernel selection.

Sam (Infra): Target infra? They said "private in our VPC". For p95 ~250ms at seq_len=512, batch=1: recommended GPU tier is A10G or H100 (depending on budget). With quantized q4 and optimized kernels that'll hit latency SLO. Dedicated reserved capacity becomes cheaper if sustained RPS > ~10.

Thor (Security): Cove Labs requires KMS integration, full audit logs, and encrypted caches. Private deployment supports KMS/HSM and audit retention — we need their contact to walk through the questionnaire. Any data residency reqs?

Ana (AE): They want a rough monthly price comparison: hosted (pay-as-you-go), dedicated small pool, private one-off + support. Customer expects ~40k tokens/day (mostly generation).

Devin (SE): Ballpark: hosted PAYG for this workload ~ $700-$1,000/mo (depends on generation length); Dedicated small reserved node (1-2 GPUs) ~$3k-$6k/mo committed; Private (air-gapped / customer infra) = initial infra + license + support, typically $30k+ one-time + monthly support. I'll confirm with pricing ops.

Marta (ML Eng): Also ask them to run our quick eval harness (we provide a script). We need: latency traces, sample outputs for our eval suite, and a couple of failing prompts so we can tune temperature/top-p fallbacks. If model lacks KV-cache support we need code changes.

Ana (AE): Attaching the small model manifest they sent — copied below.

Ana (AE): ```
name: langridge-13b-quant
format: transformers
quantization: q4_0
architecture: causal
tokenizer: sentencepiece
kv_cache: true
custom_ops: []
```

Devin (SE): That looks good — transformers + q4_0 + kv_cache=true is compatible. Two follow-ups: (1) confirm tokenizer files (spm model/vocab), (2) ask for a sample checkpoint we can try in a sandbox.

Sam (Infra): For onboarding we'll run conversion and a quick perf run:```bash
# convert and smoke test
docker run --rm -v $(pwd):/models redwood/convert:latest 
  --input /models/langridge-checkpoint --output /models/langridge-13b-q4
redwood-smoke --model /models/langridge-13b-q4 --seq 256 --batch 1
```
If smoke passes we schedule a canary private deploy and toggle routing to fallback to an open 13B variant.

Thor (Security): I'll queue their security questionnaire in the tracker and send them our SSA.ana@redwood link. Need org name + SOC2 contact.

Ana (AE): Thanks all — I'll collect the tokenizer + small checkpoint and their questionnaire contact. Cove Labs legal also asked about SLA for Dedicated; can someone draft a handoff note for sales ops?

Devin (SE): I'll draft the handoff with perf numbers and fallback policy.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary deployment window created for 2026-06-03 03:00 UTC (placeholder) :rocket:

Sam (Infra): FYI — if they want <200ms p95 we'll likely need H100s and more tuning; call it out in the proposal.

Ana (AE): Great — will update Cove Labs and loop back with artifacts. :thumbsup:
